start: Settings, Rest timer and sounds page

steps.action: Open Settings, Rest timer and sounds
user_sees: Rows 'Default rest' with its time on the right, 'Workout sounds', 'Rest-over sound', 'Ring through Do Not Disturb' (Android only), the rest alerts check, and 'Show "In use" screen after each set'
must_not: A default rest that is not the one saved

steps.action: Tap 'Default rest' and pick 2:00
user_sees: Sheet 'Default rest' with 'Used for every exercise that has no rest time of its own.'; it closes and the row shows 2:00
must_not: The sheet closing without saving

steps.action: In a workout, tick a set of an exercise with no rest of its own
user_sees: A 2:00 rest starts
must_not: The old default used

start: Settings, Rest timer and sounds page, Workout sounds on

steps.action: Tap 'Rest-over sound'
user_sees: Sheet 'Rest-over sound' with 'The sound when your rest is over. The MettleUp chime is the default.'
must_not: No sound list

steps.action: Tap two sounds in turn, then close
user_sees: Each sound plays once as it is tapped; the sheet stays open; the row shows the last one
must_not: The sheet closing after one tap
A sound playing twice

steps.action: Finish a rest in a workout, with the screen on and then off
user_sees: The chosen sound plays both times
must_not: One sound in the app and another with the screen off

start: Settings, Rest timer and sounds page

steps.action: Turn on 'Show "In use" screen after each set'
user_sees: The caption about BENCH IN USE or MACHINE IN USE
must_not: The switch flipping back

steps.action: In a workout, tick a set on a machine exercise
user_sees: The big 'MACHINE IN USE' sign with the rest clock
must_not: The sign on an exercise the member turned off on its In use screen

start: Settings, Rest timer and sounds page

steps.action: Pick a default rest while the phone cannot save it
user_sees: In the sheet: 'Couldn't save it. It applies until the app closes.'
must_not: The sheet closing as if saved

steps.action: Turn 'Workout sounds' off
user_sees: Rest-over sound caption: 'Workout sounds are off: Rest is over only buzzes'
must_not: A bell when rest is over with sounds off

steps.action: Open the page on an iPhone
user_sees: No 'Ring through Do Not Disturb' row
must_not: A switch that does nothing on iPhone

start: Settings, Rest timer and sounds page, default rest 2:00

steps.action: Tap 'Default rest' and pick Off
user_sees: The row shows 'Off'

steps.action: Tick a set of an exercise with no rest of its own
user_sees: No rest timer starts
must_not: A rest started from the old default

steps.action: Set it back to 1:30
user_sees: Row 1:30; the next tick starts 1:30
must_not: The Off setting kept

start: Android phone in Do Not Disturb, a workout open

steps.action: With 'Ring through Do Not Disturb' off, let a rest end
user_sees: Rest is over is silent (buzz only if Do Not Disturb allows)
must_not: A ring through Do Not Disturb with the switch off

steps.action: Turn the switch on and let a rest end
user_sees: Rest is over rings through Do Not Disturb
must_not: The ring still blocked with the switch on
